camel_example: aliyun ess DescribeElasticStrength --region cn-hangzhou --ScalingGroupId 'asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000' --SystemDiskCategories.1 cloud --ImageFamily CentOS7 --ScalingGroupIds.1 'asg-bp14wlu85wrpchm00000' --ImageName 'ubuntu_18_04_x64_20G_alibase_20231225.vhd' --PriorityStrategy NoSpot --VSwitchIds.1 'vsw-bp1whw2u46cn8zubm0000' --Ipv6AddressCount 1 --ImageId 'centos6u5_64_20G_aliaegis0000.vhd' --DataDiskCategories.1 cloud_essd --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceTypes.1 'ecs.g6.large' --SpotStrategy NoSpot
description_en: The validity of a scaling group configuration largely determines the success rate of scale-out operations. Auto Scaling uses elastic strength to describe the validity of scaling configurations, quantifying configuration quality and helping you optimize scaling configurations accordingly
description_zh: 伸缩组配置的有效性很大程度决定了扩容过程的成功率。弹性伸缩通过弹性强度描述伸缩配置的有效性，让配置的优良程度量化，帮助用户针对性的优化伸缩配置
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-elastic-strength --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --instance-types ecs.g6.large --priority-strategy NoSpot --system-disk-categories cloud --scaling-group-ids asg-bp14wlu85wrpchm00000 --spot-strategy NoSpot --vswitchids vsw-bp1whw2u46cn8zubm0000 --image-id centos6u5_64_20G_aliaegis0000.vhd --image-name ubuntu_18_04_x64_20G_alibase_20231225.vhd --image-family CentOS7 --data-disk-categories cloud_essd --ipv6-address-count 1 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeElasticStrength

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The collection of instance types for ECS instances. If specified, this parameter overrides the instance types in the scaling configuration
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例的实例规格的集合。
传入时，覆盖伸缩配置中的实例规格
parameters.name: instance_types

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is deprecated. Use SpotStrategy instead.

The preemption policy for pay-as-you-go instances. If specified, this parameter overrides the preemption policy configured for the scaling group. Valid values:

NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance with a maximum price limit.
SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance priced at the current market rate.

Default value: NoSpot
parameters.help_zh:
此字段已废弃，请使用SpotStrategy。

后付费实例的抢占策略。传入时覆盖伸缩组配置的抢占策略，取值范围：

NoSpot：普通的按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。

默认值：NoSpot
parameters.name: priority_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The system cloud disk types. If specified, this parameter overrides the system cloud disk types in the scaling configuration. Valid values:
cloud: basic cloud disk.
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: Enterprise SSD (ESSD).

If you do not specify a scaling group ID, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
多个系统盘类型。 传入时，覆盖伸缩配置中的系统盘类型。取值范围：
cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘。

当不指定伸缩组ID时，需要传入此参数
parameters.name: system_disk_categories

parameters.help_en: The IDs of scaling groups for batch queries
parameters.help_zh: 批量查询时的查询伸缩组的ID列表
parameters.name: scaling_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The preemption policy for instances. Valid values:

NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance with a maximum price limit.
SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance priced at the current market rate.

Default value: NoSpot
parameters.help_zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。

默认值：NoSpot
parameters.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of multiple vSwitches.
If you do not specify a scaling group ID, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定多个交换机ID。
当不指定伸缩组ID时，需要传入此参数
parameters.name: vswitchids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the image file. The image resource used for automatic creation of instances.
If you do not specify a scaling group ID, you must specify at least one of ImageId, ImageName, or ImageFamily
parameters.help_zh:
镜像文件ID，自动创建实例时使用的镜像资源。
当不指定伸缩组ID时，需要至少指定ImageId、ImageName、ImageFamily中的一个
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the image. Image names are unique within a region. If ImageId is specified, ImageName is ignored.

You cannot use ImageName to specify images from Alibaba Cloud Marketplace.
If you do not specify a scaling group ID, you must specify at least one of ImageId, ImageName, or ImageFamily
parameters.help_zh:
镜像文件名称，同一个地域内镜像名称唯一。如果设置了ImageId，ImageName将被忽略。


不支持通过ImageName设置镜像市场镜像。
当不指定伸缩组ID时，需要至少指定ImageId、ImageName、ImageFamily中的一个
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the image family. If you specify this parameter, the latest available image in the specified image family is used to create instances. If ImageId is already specified, you cannot specify this parameter.
If you do not specify a scaling group ID, you must specify at least one of ImageId, ImageName, or ImageFamily
parameters.help_zh:
镜像族系名称，通过设置该参数来获取当前镜像族系内最新的可用镜像，用于创建实例。如果已经设置了参数ImageId，则不能设置该参数。
当不指定伸缩组ID时，需要至少指定ImageId、ImageName、ImageFamily中的一个
parameters.name: image_family

parameters.help_en:
The elastic strength when multiple data cloud disk types are specified. If a data cloud disk type does not match, the specific mismatched disk type is returned in the query result.
If you do not specify a scaling group ID, you can specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
查询指定了多种数据盘类型时的弹性强度，当存在数据盘类型不匹配时，查询结果中会返回具体的不匹配磁盘类型。
当不指定伸缩组ID时，可以传入此参数
parameters.name: data_disk_categories

parameters.help_en:
The number of IPv6 addresses. If the instance type does not meet the IPv6 address count requirement, the elastic strength is degraded.
If you do not specify a scaling group ID, you can specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6地址数。当实例规格不满足IPv6地址数量要求时，会导致弹性强度差。
当不指定伸缩组ID时，可以传入此参数
parameters.name: ipv6_address_count
